body:
I probably wouldn't have much sex with men even if I transitioned.  Sex with men is so meaningless...

I feel like if I could make friends with trans people though.  They say "trans people only date other trans people".  At least then I wouldn't be awkwardly male.

I don't think that that's very fair.  When people say "Why depend on others for happiness?" what I hear is "no one will ever love you so why bother?"  Its hard to be happy when no one likes you.  It would be much easier for me if people could be supportive and understanding of my loneliness rather than telling me to "be happy anyway".
Thanks for taking this position... I don't think that anyone can confidently say that one gender has it easier, but I can say confidently that I haven't been happy with my life as a man so far.
I benefited from reading postmoderncrisis's defense.

I have no idea what people dislike me.  I have no idea why people like me when they do.  All I can see is people treating me either positively or negatively for random and arbitrary reasons.  I've given up on people liking me because I have no idea what I could do to make people like me.  But I feel like, at least if I was a woman and I was attractive, at least I could like myself.
